item.tib: ma rgyud thugs rje nyi ma'i 'bras bu rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i rgyud
gsang mchog mthar thug ma rgyud thugs rje nyi ma 'bras bu rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i rgyud
item.note: this the third and last of the three main secret mother tantra texts. it was revealed by gu-ru rnon-rtse (b. 1136) at dung-phor of rta-nag. see karmay, treasury, pp. 166-167. the lineage that occurs in the colophon to the 1971 tbmc edition's version of this text is discussed in martin, mandala cosmogony, pp. 33-34.
